bibl.title: Anuṣṭhānapaddhati
bibl.note: A Descriptive Catalogue of the Sanskrit Manuscripts in the Sarasvati Mahal Library, Tanjore (Tanjore). Vols. 1–19.
Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952.

This work deals with the method of meditation to be practised by sannyāsins. A commentary on this work is written by Ayyādhvarin, a student of Kṛṣṇānanda Sarasvatī. See A Descriptive Catalogue of the Sanskrit Manuscripts in the Sarasvati Mahal Library, Tanjore (Tanjore). Vols. 1–19: vol. 17, entry 11816.
